items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats beim Finanzamt Beispielhain eingehen; die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag nach der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: The notice is dated Thursday 05.06.2025 and sent as a simple letter. Under the current (2025) version of §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, such a letter is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after dispatch: day 1 = 06.06. (Fri), day 2 = 07.06. (Sat), day 3 = 08.06. (Sun), day 4 = 09.06.2025 (Mon). 09.06.2025 is a business day (not a weekend/holiday in NRW), so the fictitious delivery date stands at 09.06.2025. Per the letter and §108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs. 1 BGB, the one-month Einspruch period begins the day after Bekanntgabe. Under §188 Abs. 2 BGB a one-month period that starts under §187 Abs. 1 ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the day of the triggering event (09.06. -> 09.07.). 09.07.2025 is a Wednesday, not a weekend day or a NRW public holiday, so no shift is needed. Deadline: 09.07.2025.

items.computation: The letter only states the refund of 679,00 € will be credited 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the next few days) after the notice date of 05.06.2025, without giving a specific calendar date, so an exact due date cannot be determined; this is an estimate/expectation rather than a legally fixed deadline.
